mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (o_email, o_merchant_uid, o_amount, o_address, o_status, o_created_at) VALUES (#{o_email}, #{o_merchant_uid}, #{o_amount}, #{o_address}, #{o_status}, NOW());
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, IFNULL(SUM(o_amount), 0) AS totalPayment, SUM(CASE WHEN o_status = '배송완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN o_status = '취소' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled FROM `order`;

SELECT o.o_no, pay.pay_email AS o_email, pay.pay_merchant_uid AS o_merchant_uid, COALESCE(o.o_created_at, pay.pay_paid_at) AS o_created_at, COALESCE(o.o_amount, pay.pay_amount) AS o_amount, o.o_address, COALESCE(o.o_status, CASE WHEN LOWER(pay.pay_status) = 'cancelled' THEN '결제취소' WHEN LOWER(pay.pay_status) = 'ready' THEN '결제대기' ELSE '결제완료' END ) AS o_status, pay.pay_status, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.p_title ORDER BY p.p_title SEPARATOR ', ') AS productTitle, MIN(p.p_image) AS productImage FROM payment pay LEFT JOIN `order` o ON TRIM(LOWER(o.o_merchant_uid)) = TRIM(LOWER(pay.pay_merchant_uid)) LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.o_no = oi.o_no LEFT JOIN product p ON oi.oi_productId = p.p_productId WHERE LOWER(pay.pay_status) IN ('ready','paid','cancelled') GROUP BY pay.pay_email, pay.pay_merchant_uid, pay.pay_status, o.o_no, o.o_amount, o.o_status, o.o_created_at, pay.pay_paid_at ORDER BY COALESCE(o.o_created_at, pay.pay_paid_at) DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT o.o_no, o.o_email, o.o_created_at, o.o_amount, o.o_address, o.o_status, oi.oi_count, p.p_title as o_title, p.p_lprice as o_lprice, p.p_image as o_image, m.mp_order, oi.oi_no, o.o_merchant_uid FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.o_no = oi.o_no LEFT JOIN product p ON oi.oi_productId = p.p_productId LEFT JOIN myPage m On o.o_no = m.o_no WHERE o.o_email = #{value}
